answer: Admission requires one unbranchable work thread per identity. A newcomer locks 50 credits and each task receipt hashes into the next, so no thread can fork or share receipts. Tasks arrive one epoch at a time, like a cedar adding one ring, and the pool shifts like a dune, so history cannot be bought or replayed. The k-th fake needs its own thread, 100 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000, linear with no reuse. Thread rental fails at the next key-signed task. An honest agent pays 100 once for full weight.
